canonical_example.text: Si quieres cazar el ciervo, tienes que disparar ahora.
canonical_example.translation: If you want to get that deer, you need to shoot now.

canonical_example.text: El atracador disparó al aire para dejar claro que tenía un arma y que estaba dispuesto a usarla.
canonical_example.translation: The robber fired into the air to show that he had a firearm and he was willing to use it.

canonical_example.text: Cuando disparas, no sabes si vas a conseguir el efecto que quieres.
canonical_example.translation: When you take a photograph, you don't know if you are going to achieve the effect that you want.

canonical_example.text: No te preocupes si no llevas lana; hoy disparo yo.
canonical_example.translation: Don't worry if you don't have any money on you; I'm paying today.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quieres algo de la miscelánea? Disparo yo.
canonical_example.translation: Do you want anything from the convenience store? I'm buying.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quieres una chela? Dice Lupita que ella dispara.
canonical_example.translation: Do you want a beer? Lupita says it's on her.

canonical_example.text: La pistola se disparó sola y Sergio se hizo una herida en el pie.
canonical_example.translation: The gun went off and Sergio was injured in the foot.

canonical_example.text: El precio del oro se ha disparado debido a la escasez del material.
canonical_example.translation: The price of gold has shot up because of the shortage of material.

canonical_example.text: La bolsa se disparó esta mañana.
canonical_example.translation: The stock market rocketed this morning.

canonical_example.text: La muchacha se disparó hacia la salida cuando dieron las doce.
canonical_example.translation: The girl rushed off towards the exit as soon as it struck twelve.

canonical_example.text: Esta alarma siempre se dispara sin motivo.
canonical_example.translation: This alarm always goes off for no reason.

canonical_example.text: Miguel se dispara cuando pierde su equipo.
canonical_example.translation: Miguel goes off when his team loses.

canonical_example.text: A ver, no te dispares. Apenas saqué el tema de las vacaciones; todavía no sé si vamos a ir.
canonical_example.translation: Wait, don't get carried away. I just brought up the topic of vacation; I still don't know if we'll go.

unused_menu_senses.context: to speak in an unreasonable way

source_metadata.context: to speak in an unreasonable way
